label: Inventory Status
purpose: Display stock level and create urgency with a low-stock message
_notes:
in_custom_text is the in-stock message and is inline_richtext (must NOT be wrapped in

tags); it supports the literal placeholders [quantity] (current stock count) and [date] (computed from in_delivery_days), e.g. 'Ships by [date] — [quantity] left'. show_low_stock_when controls whether the low-stock message only appears once stock drops to inventory_threshold or always shows. There is no separate custom-text setting for the low-stock or out-of-stock states in the current schema — only the in-stock message is author-editable, the rest is layout/color/animation and is intentionally excluded.
